observation.command:
cd /tmp/nebu-bootstrap
set -e
# 1. fresh login start (new PKCE/state/nonce in admin session)
curl -s -b cookies.txt -c cookies.txt -D s1.txt --max-time 10 "http://localhost:8080/admin/login/start?mode=bootstrap" -o /dev/null
AUTH_URL=$(grep -i '^location:' s1.txt | tr -d '\r' | sed 's/^[Ll]ocation: //')
echo "AUTH_URL=$AUTH_URL" | cut -c1-120
rm -f dex_cookies.txt
# 2. follow dex redirect chain to login form
curl -s -c dex_cookies.txt --max-time 10 -L "$AUTH_URL" -o dexform.html -w "dex form: [%{http_code}] [%{url_effective}]\n"
FORM_ACTION=$(grep -o 'action="[^"]*"' dexform.html | head -1 | sed 's/action="//;s/"//')
echo "FORM_ACTION=$FORM_ACTION"
# 3. login
curl -s -b dex_cookies.txt -c dex_cookies.txt \
  --data-urlencode "login=kai@example.com" --data-urlencode "password=changeme" \
  -D dexh.txt -o /dev/null -e "http://dex:5556/dex/auth/local/login" \
  "http://dex:5556/$FORM_ACTION"
CB_URL=$(grep -i '^location:' dexh.txt | tr -d '\r' | sed 's/^[Ll]ocation: //')
echo "CB_URL: ${CB_URL:0:120}..."
echo "$CB_URL" > callback_url.txt
